title: design-system.json -- per-project locked design system (v0.1 contract)
description: Contract for the locked design system every UI project must carry before screens are built (rule: .claude/rules/design-system.md). Lives at repo root as design-system.json, or .forge/design/<project-slug>.json for VibePromptRig plugin customers. identity.{direction,references,personality,density} are the minimum lockable identity; antiGenericSignals[] lists THIS-product-only visual signals Claude must preserve (the concrete anti-generic gate). The schema enforces structure -- it never prescribes a look.

references.description: Real products/sites whose feel this project aims at

antiGenericSignals.description: THIS-product-only signals Claude must preserve. Empty = gate has no teeth yet; fill before locking.
